description: Giving each subagent its own clean context window for noisy work, so only a condensed result reaches the lead.
How many times more tokens a design spends than a single chat call. Anthropic reported about 4× for agents and 15× for its multi-agent research system.
A task that splits into many independent directions explored at once, such as comparing many vendors. The best fit for parallel workers.
An assumption carried by an action (style, interpretation, scope). Parallel agents that cannot see each other's work make conflicting ones.
Peer agents coordinating through handoffs or shared state without a central planner. `emerging`.
Several agents answer the same question, then compare arguments or vote. Useful for high-stakes judgments, costly, and prone to agreement bias.
